observations.code_quote: | `accountRelationshipsLogic`   | Relationship assignments for one account (keyed by `accountId`): fetches the full timeline once (`include_history=true` on the nested relationships endpoint) — the `displayedRelationships` selector (current assignments first, newest first, optionally narrowed by `definitionFilter`) feeds the (paginated) history tab, the `activeRelationships` selector feeds the sidebar summary. Also owns the tab's mutations: `assignRelationship` (definition picker + `MemberSelect`, POSTs the assign endpoint), `endRelationship` (per active row, POSTs the end endpoint), and `deleteRelationship` (admin-only, confirmation-gated hard delete). All mutations share the `relationshipSaving` guard, reload the timeline, and force-refresh the list's data nodes so relationship columns stay in sync.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
